dimension_justifications.soundness: The ownership logic is plausible, but GDN has no independent semantic oracle, normalized storage identity is underspecified in the reviewer object, and the replay package is absent.
dimension_justifications.presentation: Scope and denominators are clear, but stale artifact paths obstruct verification.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The integration is useful but narrow: one runtime, geometry, and schedule.

paper_summary: ForkAudit audits hybrid KV/GDN fork ownership with a four-cell factorial, storage witnesses, selected FP32 rows, mutants, and explicit memory denominators.
strongest_verified_contribution: Phase-aware ownership decomposition and four-cell relative equivalence in one frozen implementation.
questions: How is normalized physical storage identity established?
Can GDN transitions be checked independently?

issues.observed_evidence: All cells share one GDN implementation; the independent oracle covers attention only.
issues.why_it_matters: Storage separation and relative equality cannot exclude a common wrong recurrent update.
issues.required_fix: Add an independent GDN transition oracle or narrow all semantic language to relative equivalence and ownership.
issues.verification_test: Recompute selected transitions without calling candidate update code and inject wrong-base/wrong-transition mutants.
issues.evidence_needed: Independent recurrent sidecars or narrowed wording.

issues.observed_evidence: The reviewer object did not expose the producer primitive that assigns equal normalized IDs to shared physical allocations.
issues.why_it_matters: Interval arithmetic cannot recover an alias missed during identity assignment.
issues.required_fix: Expose the storage identity algorithm and adversarial alias/view tests.
issues.verification_test: Test wrappers, offsets, sliced/transposed/overlapping/disjoint views, and address reuse.

issues.location: Reproducibility statement and Appendix artifact map
issues.observed_evidence: The frozen snapshot omits the executable replay root and manuscript build dependencies.
issues.why_it_matters: A manifest of an unavailable package is insufficient for an executable audit paper.
issues.required_fix: Include the complete anonymous supplement and build closure.
issues.verification_test: Replay and compile from a clean extraction.

issues.why_it_matters: Expected-gate detection alone has limited evidence of incremental value.
issues.required_fix: Report detector subsets, first detection, and unique catches.

issues.observed_evidence: The table does not expose live-object topology and source retention per arm.
issues.why_it_matters: The controlled allocator contrast can be misread as optimized serving savings.
issues.required_fix: Add a component/live-object ledger or an explicit source-retention statement and labeled counterfactual.
issues.verification_test: Reconcile endpoints to components and residual.
issues.evidence_needed: Archived ledger or clearly labeled accounting.

review_limitations: The full replay package was not present in the frozen reviewer snapshot.
